item.title: With win Down Under, Anthony Kim's improbable comeback from the depths is complete
item.description: In a vintage performance, Kim, 40, won LIV Golf Adelaide, his first win in 16 years and after over a decade away from the game battling injuries, substance abuse and other struggles.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler makes three eagles, fires 63 and puts scare into field at Pebble Beach
item.description: Scottie Scheffler made six birdies, three eagles and three bogeys in a remarkable Sunday 63 at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026 prize money: Full payout from $20 million purse
item.description: Here's how much of the $20 million purse will be paid out to Collin Morikawa for winning the PGA Tour's first signature event, the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am.

item.title: Morikawa on 7th PGA Tour win: Belief in self never wavered
item.description: Collin Morikawa won his 7th PGA Tour tournament on Sunday, claiming the first signature event of the year and finishing on top of the leaderboard for the first time since October 2023. Morikawa followed a 10-under 62 on Saturday with a 5-under 67 in the final round to hold off a late charge from Scottie Scheffler, who finished T-3 with Tommy Fleetwood.

item.title: Scheffler: Never know what's going to happen on Sunday
item.description: Scottie Scheffler shot 9-under 63 in the final round of the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, finishing with T-3 with Tommy Fleetwood. Scheffler has finished inside the top 10 for the 18th consecutive PGA Tournament.

item.title: PGA Tour Champions Highlights 2026: Chubb Classic
item.description: David Toms won the 2026 Chubb Classic at the Tiburón Golf Club in Naples, Fla. Toms had a terrific holeout on the 18th hole that set him up for a birdie putt, giving him a one-stroke win over Justin Leonard, Boo Weekley and Michael Wright.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, Final Round
item.description: Scottie Scheffler recorded three eagles in a single round for the first time in his career Sunday, but the world's top-ranked player fell two strokes shy to Collin Morikawa.

item.title: Collin Morikawa birdies last to end 28-month drought at Pebble Beach
item.description: Collin Morikawa had gone 28 months since his last win, and he was reminded Sunday at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-am why it’s never easy.

item.title: Where does Anthony Kim stand in the Official World Golf Ranking after LIV win?
item.description: Anthony Kim has moved up from No. 847 to No. 203 on the Official World Golf Ranking after his win at LIV Golf Adelaide.

item.title: Kim's win the best thing that could happen for LIV?
item.description: Was Anthony Kim's win at LIV Adelaide the best thing that could happen for the circuit? Rex Hoggard and Ryan Lavner discus in the Golf Channel Podcast with Rex & Lav.
